Quarto 1.11 includes the following new features:

- [Definition list divs](/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.qmd#definition-lists): Write definition lists as a `.definition-list` div holding a nested bullet list, the definition list syntax of Quarto 2.

Dependency updates:

- `deno` updated to 2.9.8 as a security fix. Deno 2.7.14, bundled with Quarto 1.10 and earlier 1.11 pre-releases, still trusted the compromised eMudhra / emSign intermediate certificate authorities, whose private keys can be recovered from their public certificates ([Mozilla bug 2083449](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2083449), [incident details](https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/)). An attacker on the network could use them to impersonate any HTTPS site to `quarto publish`, `quarto add`, `quarto use template`, `quarto install`, and TypeScript scripts run by Quarto. Deno 2.9.8 [distrusts these certificate authorities](https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/37046). See [quarto-dev/quarto-cli#15152](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/15152) for details.
